deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve Cardano ecosystem KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Operate a smart contract-governed DAO process for evaluating proposals, coordinating feedback, distributing funds transparently, and tracking funded work results.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue developing KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data and work with dReps on KPI standardization.
Use an independent council and multisig administrator to hold and disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated.
request.what: Cardano Builder DAO treasury withdrawal to continue and expand a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through measurable KPIs.
The proposal says treasury funding should be connected to measurable outcomes including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and total value locked.
The DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

Round 1 allegedly included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, an 83% governance participation rate, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a transparent smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 allegedly added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved an 88% participation rate among members.
The proposal states that Version 1 of the KPI dashboard enabled public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moved toward KPI tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.

The proposal says official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.
An independent council composed of dRep DAO members would receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds before deployment, and oversee disbursement according to referenced milestones.
Any ADA held by the administrator before disbursement would be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The CB DAO says it returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an AdaStat transaction link.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and expand a DAO-based funding mechanism for Cardano builders, with stated emphasis on KPI-linked allocation, transparent governance, independent milestone-based administration, and repayment of unused funds.
